items.title: Is DaVita (DVA) Cheap After Its Expanded HD Rollout Reached All U.S. Centers?
items.summary: DaVita (DVA) just hit a kidney care milestone, rolling out its Expanded hemodialysis therapy across all U.S. centers, with physicians quickly prescribing it for most eligible patients. DaVita’s latest product roll out comes after a strong share price run this year, with a year-to-date share price return of 40.63% and a 1-year total shareholder return of 33.91%.
